name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A dark input that understands plain-language dates and resolves them to a calendar date. A calendar button is there for picking a day visually; no time is asked for.
use: A form needs one calendar date and you want typing a phrase to work as well.
avoid: Placeholder still says date and time although the time picker is switched off here.
a11y: The input has a placeholder but no linked label; the calendar button's text is screen-reader only. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide, thin dark bar with rounded corners and a light grey border. A small square calendar icon button sits at the left, followed by grey placeholder text across a long input.
behaves: Typing a phrase like "next friday" and pressing Enter or clicking away replaces it with a formatted date. The border lightens while the field has focus. The calendar button opens a day-picker popover, though the clip never shows it.
customise: No props: the placeholder text, calendar-only mode and width are set in the file and need a source edit.
weight: light: A single input plus a calendar library; idle until opened.
